name: @muxos/plugin-infra-launcher-instance-owner
description: One muxos per account, enforced: which checkout this account's muxos runs from (the checkout main's deploy names, and the one the background service is registered to follow), and assertThisInstance — the refusal `./muxos start` and a main `./muxos build` raise, as an installer notice, when another checkout already holds it, so a second copy can never take over the running one.
